source.title: The QCD axion, precisely
source.authors: Giovanni Grilli di Cortona; Edward Hardy; Javier Pardo Vega; Giovanni Villadoro
source.reviewLevel: Exact equations and surrounding scope checked against versioned author arXiv HTML of the source manuscript and publisher bibliographic record. No original PDF screenshot inspection or independent full derivation claimed.
source.role: Author primary theoretical derivation and 2016 numerical prediction; not original 1977–78 axion prediction or a 2026 update

formulaProposals.title: QCD axion–gluon topological interaction (term)
formulaProposals.sourceLocation: Section 2, Eq. (1), second term; author arXiv v2 HTML
variables: f_a: effective QCD anomaly-normalized axion decay constant
G_munu and dual Gtilde_munu: QCD gluon field strength and its dual, color indices summed implicitly
assumptions: Low-energy effective theory below PQ and electroweak breaking scales; leading order in 1/f_a and weak couplings
The quoted interaction is ONLY the second term of complete Eq. (1), which also includes kinetic, photon and derivative matter interactions
Color anomaly normalization is absorbed into f_a; theta angle removed by field shift per source
Do not apply this QCD-specific term as a universal defining relation for generic ALPs
formulaProposals.units: In natural units Lagrangian density has energy^4; a/f_a dimensionless, G_munu Gtilde^munu energy^4
formulaProposals.nonClaim: Not a complete QCD axion Lagrangian, not a statement about all axion-like particles.

formulaProposals.title: Zero-temperature QCD axion topological-susceptibility mass
formulaProposals.sourceLocation: Section 2.1, Eq. (22), final equality; author arXiv v2 HTML
variables: chi_top: physical QCD topological susceptibility at theta=0
f_a: normalized QCD axion decay constant
assumptions: QCD axion arising from the anomalous QCD theta coupling in the source's normalization
Evaluate mass at T=0 in the source's Section 2; finite-temperature susceptibility changes
General QCD relation rather than an arbitrary ALP mass formula
formulaProposals.units: chi_top has energy^4 and f_a has energy; chi_top/f_a^2 is energy^2
formulaProposals.nonClaim: Not experimental identification of dark matter; does not fix f_a without an independent measurement.

formulaProposals.title: 2016 NLO QCD axion mass estimate
formulaProposals.sourceLocation: Section 2.1, Eq. (26), second equality, plus uncertainties following Eq. (26)
variables: m_a: QCD axion mass at T=0 in microelectronvolts
f_a: QCD-normalized axion decay constant measured in GeV
5.70(7): combined author 2016 uncertainty, corresponding to separate 5.70(6)(4) uncertainties
assumptions: Original authors' 2016 NLO chiral perturbation/QCD input values, not claimed current as of 2026
Applies to QCD axion, NOT generic ALPs with independent masses/couplings
Numerical uncertainty comes from quark-mass ratio and higher-order QCD inputs
formulaProposals.units: m_a expressed in microelectronvolts; 10^12 GeV / f_a dimensionless
formulaProposals.nonClaim: A dated 2016 theoretical mass relation, not a universal dark-matter detection or latest PDG precision.

formulaProposals.title: Model-dependent 2016 QCD axion–photon coupling
formulaProposals.sourceLocation: Section 2.3, Eq. (45), first equality and explanation; author arXiv v2 HTML
variables: g_agg: axion-photon coupling with inverse-energy units
E/N: model-dependent electromagnetic-to-color PQ anomaly ratio
1.92(4): authors' 2016 model-independent QCD contribution and uncertainty
assumptions: QCD axion with anomaly-normalized f_a and the source's effective theory
E/N varies by ultraviolet axion model; KSVZ and DFSZ may take distinct values
Near E/N=1.92 cancellations make model-specific photon coupling small; neither zero nor universality is imposed
Finite-temperature, generic ALP and time-dependent couplings not implied
formulaProposals.units: g_agg has energy^-1, alpha_em and E/N dimensionless, f_a energy
formulaProposals.nonClaim: A model-dependent coupling, not a model-independent detectable lower bound for every QCD axion.

additionalHolds.title: Misalignment dark-matter relic abundance
additionalHolds.gate: Independently inspect original Preskill-Wise-Wilczek, Abbott-Sikivie, and Dine-Fischler (1983) equation pages, finite-T susceptibility assumptions, pre/post-inflation symmetry breaking and cosmic string/domain-wall contributions before adding a relic formula.

additionalHolds.title: Current axion mass coefficient
additionalHolds.gate: Compare 2016 authors' NLO result with versioned 2025/2026 PDG precision inputs before presenting any numerical value as current.

additionalHolds.title: Axion-like-particle taxonomy
additionalHolds.gate: Keep generic ALPs distinct from the QCD axion; axion-gluon relation and mass are not automatically valid for an ALP with arbitrary UV origin.
